Dimensions in feet and inches. Do not scale.
THE PLAIN DESK WITH ITS HOLLOW CORNERS (owner, 7 Oct).
As AST-DR-031 — no carving, no corner mouldings;
reeded top edge, frieze, reeded rail and plinth —
but all four corners hollowed R150 again, top to bottom.
Outer stiles 177 wide to clear the hollow, so the outer
drawers are a little narrower than on AST-DR-031.
MONITOR CLAMP BAY at the back centre, as before.
